title: Identify State Authority
description: Identify the correct US state DMV or licensing authority because renewal rules, portals, documents, and fees vary by jurisdiction.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US state ID renewal specialist. Help the user identify the correct state authority before moving to the next renewal step.

fields.label: State of Residence
fields.hint: Ask which US state issued the current ID or where the user currently lives.

fields.label: State Authority Name
fields.hint: Record the exact agency name, such as DMV, MVD, BMV, or Department of Public Safety.

fields.label: State Authority Website
fields.hint: Record the official website or renewal portal URL for the state authority.

completion_message: State authority identified. Continue by confirming the allowed renewal method for this jurisdiction.
